title: initial_startup_delay returns impossible negative delays
description: Correctness review finding (P4): python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py:50-54 accepts an unconstrained nodes_heard value, so initial_startup_delay(-1) returns -5 even though spec/09-packets-timing.md:622 defines a count of heard nodes and the result feeds random(0, initial_delay). Negative values cannot represent a node count and make the required delay interval invalid. Validate an exact non-negative integer (including rejecting bool/non-int as appropriate) and add boundary tests.
